project.name: Atlas Launch
project.description: Atlas 2.0 platform launch: billing migration, SSO, onboarding and the public API.

board.sprint_goal: Close out the launch blockers for Atlas 2.0 and freeze scope for the 30 September release.

issues.summary: Migrate billing service to the new pricing engine
issues.description: Move invoicing off the legacy pricing tables and onto the Atlas pricing engine. Includes a dual-write window and a reconciliation job that compares legacy and new invoice totals for 14 days.

comments.author: Marcus Lee
comments.body: Dual-write is live in staging. Reconciliation found 3 mismatches, all rounding on annual plans.

comments.author: Sofia Alvarez
comments.body: We cannot ship the launch without this. Treating it as the top blocker.

issues.summary: SSO login loop for Okta tenants
issues.description: Okta-backed tenants bounce between the IdP and the Atlas login page when the SAML assertion carries a nameId of type persistent. Reproduces on the tenant sandbox 'northwind'.

comments.author: Dana Whitfield
comments.body: Blocked on Okta support ticket #4471 — waiting for them to confirm the assertion format on their side.

comments.author: Yuki Tanaka
comments.body: Two enterprise customers hit this during the beta. Reproduction steps are in the ticket description.

issues.summary: Publish the Atlas public API reference
issues.description: Generate the OpenAPI reference from the service schema and publish it to docs.northstar.example/atlas. Includes the authentication guide and three worked examples.

comments.author: Priya Raman
comments.body: Reference is generated and the examples read well. Just needs a final pass on the auth guide before we close it.

issues.description: Show a five-step checklist the first time an admin opens a new workspace: invite team, connect identity provider, import data, set billing contact, publish first project.

comments.author: Dana Whitfield
comments.body: Four of the five steps are wired up. The billing contact step depends on ATL-101 landing first.

issues.summary: Load test the API gateway at 5x launch traffic
issues.description: Run a sustained 30 minute load test at five times the projected launch peak (12k requests/minute) and record p95 latency, error rate and autoscaling behaviour.

comments.author: Tom Becker
comments.body: Test rig is ready. I need a staging window where billing is not dual-writing so the numbers are clean.

issues.summary: Invoice PDF shows the wrong currency for AUD accounts
issues.description: Australian accounts render invoice totals with a US dollar symbol even though the amounts are correct in AUD. Affects the PDF only; the web view is correct.

comments.author: Marcus Lee
comments.body: Fixed the currency formatter and added a regression test for AUD, EUR and JPY.

issues.summary: Data import from the legacy Atlas 1.x workspace
issues.description: One-click import of projects, members and attachments from Atlas 1.x. Must be resumable and must not duplicate records if the import is retried.

issues.summary: Launch runbook and on-call rotation for release week
issues.description: Write the launch day runbook: cutover order, rollback triggers, comms templates, and the on-call rotation covering 29 September to 3 October.

comments.author: Priya Raman
comments.body: Rollback triggers need to name the exact metric thresholds, not 'if it looks bad'.
